updates.deck: Aging affects cellular organelles differently, but whether subcellular aging predicts human disease remains unknown. updates.name: HealthFlux
updates.label: Paper · medRxiv · 2026
updates.deck: A world model of human health that predicts 1,256 diseases and death over twenty years.
updates.title: A world model simulates the latent dynamics of human health
updates.authors: Wang, Z., Zhang, O., Wang, J., Jiang, Y., Ma, Z. C., …, Gladyshev, V. N., Wyss-Coray, T., Ying, K.
updates.description: HealthFlux is a world model built from 502,166 UK Biobank participants. It treats a person's health as one hidden state that changes between visits and is updated by each new blood test, diagnosis, molecular profile or brain and body MRI. In held-out participants it predicts 1,256 diseases and death over twenty years, and it was tested in four independent US cohorts.

updates.name: ClockBase Agent
updates.label: Paper · bioRxiv · 2025
updates.deck: AI agents reanalyzed 43,602 intervention-control comparisons and found more than 500 interventions associated with lower biological age.
updates.title: Autonomous AI Agents Discover Aging Interventions from Millions of Molecular Profiles
updates.authors: K Ying, A Tyshkovskiy, A Moldakozhayev, H Wang, …, L Cong, A Regev, J Leskovec, T Wyss-Coray, VN Gladyshev
updates.description: ClockBase Agent uses AI agents to reanalyze millions of public human and mouse methylation and RNA-seq samples with more than 40 aging clocks. Across 43,602 intervention-control comparisons it found more than 500 interventions associated with lower biological age. One candidate, ouabain, slowed frailty progression and reduced neuroinflammation in aged mice.

updates.name: Biolearn
updates.label: Paper · Nature Aging · 2025
updates.deck: An open-source library that evaluates 39 aging biomarkers on standardized data from more than 20,000 people.
updates.title: A Unified Framework for Systematic Curation and Evaluation of Aging Biomarkers
updates.authors: K Ying, S Paulson, A Eames, A Tyshkovskiy, …, VN Gladyshev
updates.description: Biolearn is an open-source library that standardizes public datasets and published clocks so that aging biomarkers can be compared on the same samples. It evaluates 39 aging biomarkers on standardized data from more than 20,000 people.
